HISD Modal / Overlay

Modals are blocking dialogs. Root is role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby; the overlay is --color-surface-inverse at 60% opacity; the panel is --color-surface, --radius-xl, --shadow-4, max 512px. Focus is trapped on open and returned to the trigger on close. Non-destructive modals dismiss on Escape or backdrop click; the destructive-confirm variant ignores both and requires an explicit Confirm. The right panel is forced to data-theme="dark" — the component inherits dark purely through semantic tokens. Entrance animates scale .95→1 + opacity over --duration-base, skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.

Light theme

Non-destructive (Escape & backdrop dismiss)

A standard information / confirmation dialog. Tab cycles within the trap, Shift+Tab reverses, Escape closes, focus returns to this button.

Destructive confirm (ignores Escape & backdrop)

Reserved for irreversible actions. Escape and backdrop clicks are ignored; only the explicit Cancel or Delete buttons close it.

Dark theme

Non-destructive (Escape & backdrop dismiss)

Same component, dark tokens. No component-specific dark CSS — the surface, overlay, shadow, and text all flip via semantic tokens.

Destructive confirm (ignores Escape & backdrop)

A leading warning glyph, the danger accent, and the heading copy carry the meaning — not color alone. Confirm is required to proceed.

Update the contact details on file for this student. Changes are saved to the district record and shared with the campus office.

Preferred language and emergency-contact fields support text expansion for Spanish-language entries.

Remove enrollment?

This permanently removes the student from the 2026–2027 roster. This action cannot be undone and Escape will not dismiss it — choose an option below.

Copy-paste snippet

<!-- Trigger: any focusable control. data-modal-open points at the dialog id. -->
<button type="button" class="hisd-modal__btn hisd-modal__btn--action"
        data-modal-open="modal-info">Edit student profile</button>

<!-- Dialog: rendered once near the end of <body>, [hidden] until opened. -->
<div class="hisd-modal" id="modal-info" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"
     aria-labelledby="modal-info-title" aria-describedby="modal-info-desc" hidden>
  <div class="hisd-modal__panel" tabindex="-1">
    <header class="hisd-modal__header">
      <h2 class="hisd-modal__title" id="modal-info-title">Edit student profile</h2>
      <button type="button" class="hisd-modal__close" data-modal-close
              aria-label="Close dialog">
        <span class="hisd-modal__close-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      </button>
    </header>
    <div class="hisd-modal__body" id="modal-info-desc">
      Dialog content…
    </div>
    <footer class="hisd-modal__footer">
      <button type="button" class="hisd-modal__btn hisd-modal__btn--secondary"
              data-modal-close>Cancel</button>
      <button type="button" class="hisd-modal__btn hisd-modal__btn--action"
              data-modal-confirm>Save changes</button>
    </footer>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Destructive variant: role="alertdialog", add hisd-modal--destructive AND
     data-modal-destructive. The script then ignores Escape + backdrop clicks;
     only an explicit button closes it. -->
<div class="hisd-modal hisd-modal--destructive" id="modal-delete"
     role="alertdialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="modal-delete-title"
     data-modal-destructive hidden>
  …
  <button type="button" class="hisd-modal__btn hisd-modal__btn--danger"
          data-modal-confirm>Remove enrollment</button>
</div>

<!-- Keyboard (WAI-ARIA APG "Dialog"): focus moves into the panel on open;
     Tab / Shift+Tab cycle within the trap; Escape closes NON-destructive
     dialogs; focus returns to the trigger on close. -->
